definition: a gain; an advantage; profit.
example_en: A good profit was gained in this business.

definition: the predetermined course of events in a person's life; destiny; fate.
example_en: Everyone's destiny is different from one another.

definition: the plant Alpinia galangas of Zingiberaceae family.
example_en: The Alpinia galanga plant has medicinal properties.

definition: to see (an object that is before oneself).
example: ರಸ್ತೆ ದಾಟುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಎದುರಿನ ವಾಹನವನ್ನು ಇದಿರುಗಾಣಬೇಕು.
example_en: Before crossing the road one must see the vehicle coming from the front.

definition: a good, laudable work.
example_en: Helping the poor is a good and praiseworthy deed.

definition: to include, contain (without oneself, one's sphere, range, jurisdiction, etc.).
example_en: This project includes the neighboring towns too.

definition: an inflammation of the nasal membrane; purulent deflection in the nose.
example_en: The doctor gave him medicine for the nasal inflammation.

definition: to put the bit of a bridle into the mouth of a horse.
example: ಅಶ್ವಪಾಲಕನು ಕುದುರೆಯ ಬಾಯಿಗೆ ಕಡಿವಾಣವನ್ನು ಕೀೞಿಡು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The groom put the bit of the bridle into the horse's mouth.

definition: a strong or offensive smell; a stench.
example_en: A stench spread from the sewage water.

definition: the last day of the week; Saturday.
example_en: The fair takes place on Saturday.

definition: a rocky place or a mountain.
example_en: The whole valley could be seen from the top of the mountain.

definition: to go with; to accompany.
example_en: The friends agreed to accompany him.

definition: the state of being ruled, controlled by another or others; bondage.
example_en: He did not agree to live in bondage.

definition: a waterfall, esp. a small one; a falling body of water; a cascade.
example_en: The waterfall was flowing from the hill making a sound.

definition: to disclose, reveal or divulge one's thoughts, feelings, etc. to another or others.
example_en: He disclosed the feelings of his heart.

definition: young blades of grass, as in a lawn (periodically mowed).
example_en: After the rain, the young grass grew well.

definition: a man whose duty is to steer a ship or boat; a helmsman.
example_en: The helmsman brought the boat to the shore.

definition: Yudhiṣṭira, son of Yama, one of the main characters in the great epic Mahābhārata.
example: ಅಱಮಗನು ಧರ್ಮದ ಮಾರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದ ಮಹಾನ್ ರಾಜನಾಗಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: Yudhishthira was a great king who walked on the path of righteousness.

definition: the inner layer of the skin of humans or other animals.
example_en: The inner layer of the skin was injured by the wound.

definition: the process by which a gas, liquid or solid is dispersed homogeneously in a liquid without chemical change; solution.
example_en: The dissolving of salt in water is a natural solution process.

definition: of or relating to Indra, the lord of gods.
example: ವಾಸವ ಪದವು ಇಂದ್ರನಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಅರ್ಥ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The word Vāsava conveys a meaning relating to Indra.

definition: brave conduct; a brave nature; bravery.
example_en: His bravery was displayed on the battlefield.

definition: the fact of coming into existence; becoming.
example: ಈ ಜಗತ್ತಿನ ಅಹಣ ಹೇಗಾಯಿತು ಎಂಬುದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ.
example_en: How the coming into existence of this world happened is a big question.

definition: a pouring down of tears; a weeping with profuse tears.
example_en: A profuse flow of tears streamed from her eyes.

definition: a man whose character or reputation is maligned; a blemished or debased man; a debauchee.
example_en: They called him a debauched man.

definition: a period of suspension of work, study or other activity, usu. used for rest, recreation or travel; recess or holiday; vacation.
example_en: The children were happy when the school got a holiday.

definition: a very fat woman.
example_en: That very fat woman was finding it hard to climb the steps.

definition: the act, process or an instance of wandering.
example: ಆ ಸಾಧು ಜೀವನವಿಡೀ ಚಾರಣ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾ ಕಳೆದನು.
example_en: That sage spent his whole life wandering.

definition: the area of a hexagon.
example_en: The mathematician calculated the area of that hexagon.

definition: to withdraw esp. from what is difficult, dangerous or disagreeable ; to retreat; to make a retreat.
example_en: Seeing the danger, the soldiers retreated.

definition: to cause to confuse or confound another.
example_en: His words caused everyone to be confused.

definition: the right to inherit an ancestral property.
example_en: The son received the right to inherit his father's property.

definition: not having a centre; acentric.
example_en: This figure has an acentric design.

definition: to put forth new branch or branches.
example_en: The plant put forth new branches in the rainy season.

definition: to turn or twist (something usu. on its axis); to cause to rotate.
example: ಅವನು ಚಕ್ರವನ್ನು ತಿಪ್ಪಿ ಬಂಡಿಯನ್ನು ಮುಂದೆ ನೂಕಿದನು.
example_en: He turned the wheel and pushed the cart forward.

definition: to lick, eat a part of a thing touching it to the mouth, teeth or tongue.
example_en: The child licked and tasted the sweet on the plate.

definition: the act of restraining or constraining another or others by force; coercion.
example_en: The government exercised coercion over the people.

definition: to lose that which is complementary for making a pair; to lack one of the two parts or elements, persons that are complementary.
example_en: One slipper was lost and the other became the unmatched remaining one.

definition: a discoloured patch or blemish on the skin; a blotch.
example_en: A dark blotch appeared on his hand.

definition: a place for staying, sojourning.
example_en: A place for staying was prepared for the travelers.

definition: the physical exhaustion; weariness of the body.
example_en: After the journey, he experienced physical exhaustion.

definition: a heap of dung, sweepings, unusable articles, etc.; a dung hill.
example_en: Outside the town the dung heap has grown and is stinking.

definition: a man who eats only vegetables or vegetable foods and never eats meat and eggs; a vegetarian.
example_en: He was a vegetarian who never touched meat.

definition: the day of the month; date.
example_en: Write the date on the letter.

definition: the act of caressing, fondling or playing affectionately; a mutual merrymaking.
example_en: The children's playful fondling was lovely to watch.

definition: to seize with the hand.
example_en: He seized the snake with his hand near its neck.

definition: deeper part of a sea, lake, sea etc.
example_en: Swimming in the deeper part of the sea is dangerous.

definition: a woman having the mystic power by which she knows the happenings in the past, present and future.
example: ಆ ಸಾಧ್ವಿಯನ್ನು ಜನರು ತ್ರಿಕಾಲಜ್ಞೆ ಎಂದು ಗೌರವಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: People honoured that holy woman as one who knows past, present and future.

definition: to watch over and defend or protect from harm; to guard from or against.
example_en: God protects us from all harm.

definition: (in comp.) other; different; another.
example_en: This is different; that is from another town.

definition: a man who sells medicines or medicinal substances.
example_en: The medicine seller sells medicines in the shop.

definition: the form of Arjuna, when he was to live in-cognito.
example_en: Arjuna lived in disguise as the form he took during his incognito exile.

definition: a kind of pan-cake.
example_en: They served hot pan-cakes for breakfast in the morning.

definition: (a physician) to remove pain (by treating medically).
example_en: The physician removed the patient's pain with medicine.

definition: prohibited or forbidden by tradition, convention, religion, society or government; taboo.
example_en: Bringing meat inside the temple is forbidden.

definition: a realising or being realised; realisation; accomplishment.
example_en: The realisation of the project happened on time.

definition: the broad wooden plank used for the walls of a ship.
example: ಹಡಗಿನ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಗೋಡೆಗೆ ಎದೆವಲಗೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿಗಿಯಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They tightly fixed the broad wooden plank to the side wall of the ship.

definition: a small, open vessel or watercraft propelled by oars or paddles; a boat.
example_en: The fishermen sat in the small boat and went into the sea.

definition: (only in comp.) ten.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಗ್ರಂಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಧಿ ಎಂದರೆ ಹತ್ತು ಎಂದು ಬರೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: The old text says 'padhi' means ten.

definition: to increase the intensity, degree, extent, etc.
example_en: The music increased the enthusiasm of the gathering.

definition: the depression in the center of the surface of the abdomen indicating the point of attachment of the umbilical cord to the embryo; the navel.
example: ಹಳಗನ್ನಡ ಕೃತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪೊರ್ಕುಳ್ ಎಂಬ ಪದ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: In old Kannada works, the word 'porkuḷ' meaning navel is used.

definition: an instruction, direction or command, (whether oral or written).
example_en: We worked according to the superior's instruction.

definition: a soldier.
example_en: The soldier was standing guard at the border.

definition: the quality or condition of being apparently nothing or not existing; the feeling of nothingness.
example: ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ರೀತಿಯ ಅಬೊ ಆವರಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A kind of feeling of nothingness had settled in his mind.

definition: unused, untilled land.
example_en: Grass had grown on that untilled land.

definition: to become physically weak; to lose strength; to lose fat; to become lean.
example_en: He became very weak due to illness.

definition: a military projectile used in ancient warfare to hurl heavy objects against the defensive wall of the fortified place of one's enemy.
example_en: The enemy army used the projectile against the fort.

definition: a single hand.
example_en: That boy threw the ball with just a single hand.

definition: a person who opposes, resists, competes, challenges or vies with; a rival; a vier; a challenger; a co-candidate who is facing an election for a seat, position, etc.
example_en: His rival in the election was strong.

definition: to look through for purpose of finding something; to search; to enquire about; to investigate.
example_en: She searched everywhere for the lost key.

definition: in an extraordinary manner; extraordinarily.
example_en: He displayed extraordinary bravery.

definition: the tree Pandanus furcatus of Pandanaceae family.
example: ಕಾಡಿನ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಸೊನ್ನಗೇದಗೆ ಮರ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: A pandanus tree has grown in the middle of the forest.

definition: an archaic monetary coin.
example_en: There is a mention of the taravisa coin in the ancient text.

definition: wetness; dampness; moisture.
example_en: The dampness of the cloth had not yet dried.

definition: with fragrance; emitting a sweet smell.
example_en: The flower was emitting a sweet fragrance.

definition: a man who habitually endures, forbears or tolerates (something).
example_en: That forbearing man endured all the abuse.

definition: slope - a) a piece of ground that is not flat or level; falling ground; b) any inclined line, surface, position, etc.; slant.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಉತಾರು ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ನೀರು ಸರಾಗವಾಗಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Since there is a slope in front of the house, water flows down easily.

definition: a huge beam of wood.
example_en: The workers lifted and carried the huge wooden beam.

definition: to swim.
example_en: The children swam happily in the pond.

definition: when - a) at what time? b) on what occasion or under what circumstances?; c) at what point? 2) at that time; then; on that occasion.
example_en: At that time he was not at home.

definition: an adversary; an enemy.
example: ಆ ಮಱುವಾನಿಸ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಅವನ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಸಂಚು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That adversary was always plotting against him.

definition: to cause disagreement, dissension; to displease.
example_en: That remark caused dissension among the friends.

definition: the act of doing, performing, bringing about.
example_en: Everyone admired his act of doing it.

definition: to see; to look at.
example_en: She looked and saw the moon.

definition: a boiling or bubbling up; effervescence; ebullition.
example_en: The water in the pot came to a boil.

definition: to behave in an arrogant or overbearing manner; to be haughty.
example: ಅಧಿಕಾರ ಸಿಕ್ಕ ಕೂಡಲೇ ಅವನು ಉದ್ಧತಿಬಡಲು ಶುರುಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: As soon as he got power, he began to behave arrogantly.

definition: the quality, condition or fact of being pure, clean, lucid or bright; clarity; cleanliness; lucidity.
example: ಆ ನೀರಿನ ತೆಳುಪು ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮೆಚ್ಚಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone admired the clarity of that water.

definition: to cause to move frequently to and from; to cause to vibrate; to shake ( a thing).
example_en: The child shook the cradle.

definition: the quality or state of beng complete, entire; completeness; entireness; wholeness.
example: ಈ ಕೆಲಸದ ಪೂರಾಯ ಆಗುವವರೆಗೆ ನಾನು ಇಲ್ಲಿಯೇ ಇರುತ್ತೇನೆ.
example_en: I will stay here until this work is complete.

definition: that which solves a problem; solution.
example_en: A solution to that problem has not yet been found.

definition: an eye (in gen.).
example_en: Tears filled up in his eyes.

definition: any mode of worship that is against established religious or social code.
example_en: The improper worship caused controversy in society.

definition: short stabbing-weapon with a pointed and edged blade; a dagger.
example_en: The soldier had tucked a dagger at his waist.

definition: a statement or list of criminal acts that one is charged with.
example_en: The police filed a charge sheet against him.

definition: the state or condition of being invisible.
example_en: The mountain became invisible due to the fog.

definition: a silk thread twisted with silver or gold lace.
example_en: Gold-laced silk thread had been stitched onto her sari.

definition: a man who panegyrizes; eulogist.
example_en: The eulogist praised the king.

definition: a thick, slimy solution of mud and water.
example_en: The thick muddy slime stuck to his feet in the rainwater.

definition: a paste of lac; the liquefied lac.
example_en: The carpenter applied a paste of lac and sealed the cracks.

definition: grown; increased; developed.
example: ಈ ಮರ ಈಗ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ವೃದ್ಧ ಆಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This tree has now grown well.

definition: to laud the glory of (esp. in a song); to extol; to glorify; to praise.
example_en: The devotees praised the glory of God in song and worshipped him.

definition: an extraordinary beauty.
example_en: That maiden's extraordinary beauty attracted everyone.

definition: greatness of the mind; large-heartedness; reputation based on character, etc.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಸಘಾನ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಗೌರವ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: That person's large-heartedness brought respect to everyone.

definition: a place where supplies are kept; a storehouse; a warehouse.
example_en: Old supplies lie in the storehouse.

definition: a narrow room; a relatively small room.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ಇರುಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಕಷ್ಟದಿಂದ ಕುಳಿತರು.
example_en: Both of them sat with difficulty in that narrow room of the house.

definition: not having good, required or desirable quality.
example_en: No one trusted that man devoid of good qualities.

definition: having good-looking hips.
example_en: The poet described that woman with good-looking hips.

definition: he who has, losing his physical entity, become one with (the Supreme Being).
example_en: That sage became one with the Supreme Being in meditation.

definition: a tribe that lives in forest and mountainous region, the members of of which mainly depend on hunting of animals for their livelihood.
example_en: The Pulinda tribe lives by hunting in the forest.

definition: a half-sheet of a writing paper.
example_en: He wrote a short letter on a half-sheet of paper.

definition: totalling or amounting to one and half.
example_en: This will take one and a half hours.

definition: the goosebery tree Cicca acida ( = C. disticha) of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: The fruit of the sweet gooseberry tree is a little sweet.

definition: having, exhibiting statesmanship.
example: ಆ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ನಯಯುಕ್ತ ನಡವಳಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಗೌರವ ಗಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That minister earned respect through statesmanlike behaviour.

definition: a piece or part cut off or out; esp. - a) any of the segments of the carcass of a meat animal; b) a slice from such a segment; a cut.
example_en: The cook brought a cut piece of meat.

definition: a pleasnt dream.
example_en: The child had a pleasant dream and smiled.

definition: a branch of a plant, limb of the body, etc. that has grown or stretched inward.
example: ಗಿಡದ ಒಳಚಾಚು ಗೋಡೆಯ ಬಿರುಕಿನಿಂದ ಒಳಗೆ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The plant's inward branch had grown in through the crack in the wall.

definition: a student before entering into married life.
example_en: The celibate student was learning at the gurukula.

definition: a slit, narrow crack in a rock.
example_en: A crack was visible on the rock.

definition: the sound of a bell.
example_en: The sound of the bell was heard even from a distance.

definition: a kind of game of chance, played with stakes.
example_en: The game of chance was popular at the village fair.

definition: a man supervising serving of meals to persons sitting in a row.
example_en: The man supervising the row-meal served rice to those seated in the row.

definition: to bless.
example_en: The elders blessed the child.

definition: the sticky dirt of a cooking vessel.
example_en: She scrubbed and washed the sticky dirt off the vessel.

definition: natural mental attitude and customary outlook of mind; disposition.
example_en: His disposition was peaceful.

definition: an officer in charge of a warehouse or granary; a ware-house steward.
example: ಆ ಕೊಟ್ಟವಳ ಧಾನ್ಯದ ಲೆಕ್ಕವನ್ನು ಜಾಗರೂಕತೆಯಿಂದ ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That granary steward kept careful account of the grain.

definition: a yellow to dark brown, addicting, narcotic drug prepared from the juice of the unripe seed capsules of the opium poppy which contains such alkaloids as morphine, codeine, and papaverine, and is used as an intoxicant and medicinally to relieve pain and produce sleep; opium.
example_en: Opium was used in the preparation of medicine.

definition: either of two of existing animals species (genus Giraffa, family Giraffidae) of African ruminants, with a very long neck and legs, the tallest; giraffe.
example: ಜಿರಾಫೆ ತನ್ನ ಉದ್ದ ಕುತ್ತಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಮರದ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The giraffe eats the leaves of the tree with its long neck.

definition: love; affection; fondness.
example_en: The grandfather's affection was always there for the grandchildren.

definition: explained, delineated clearly, preceisely.
example_en: The teacher explained the meaning of the verse clearly and precisely.

definition: a stupid fellow.
example_en: No one liked that stupid fellow's work.

definition: a kind of net used by animal poachers.
example_en: The hunters set the net in the forest.

definition: an extent of land irrigated by artificial means as channels; irrigated land.
example_en: Farmers grow paddy in the irrigated land.

definition: any of the units occurring at specific points on the chromosomes, by which hereditary characters are transmitted and determined; a gene.
example: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಗುಣಾಣು ಒಂದೊಂದು ಗುಣವನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿನ ತಲೆಮಾರಿಗೆ ರವಾನಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Each gene transmits a particular trait to the next generation.

definition: a fee charged for testing the genuineness and assessing the true value (of gold, metal coin, pearl, etc.).
example: ಚಿನ್ನದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನು ನೋಟವಣ ವಸೂಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The shopkeeper collected a testing fee for checking the gold.

definition: the quality of aesthetically satisfying or being keenly to sensitive to aesthetic values.
example: ಆ ವರ್ಣಚಿತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಪೂರ್ವ ಕಲಾತ್ಮಕತೆ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Rare aesthetic quality was clearly visible in that painting.

definition: the reaping of crops; harvest.
example_en: This year the harvest has turned out well.

definition: brightness; brilliance; splendour.
example_en: Everyone was amazed seeing that brilliance.

definition: to be obedient to the wishes of; to be at the beck and call of.
example_en: The servant was always obedient to his master's wishes.

definition: absence of form or shape.
example_en: That sky-color has no fixed shape.

definition: a small, pointed stick for getting bits of food free from between the teeth; a tooth-pick.
example: ಊಟದ ನಂತರ ಅವನು ಹಲುಕಡ್ಡಿಯಿಂದ ಹಲ್ಲಿನ ಸಂದಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದ ತುಣುಕನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದನು.
example_en: After the meal he removed the bit stuck between his teeth with a toothpick.

definition: a feeble sound (of a person).
example_en: It was difficult to hear the sick person's feeble sound.

definition: absence of formalities; the quality or state of being informal.
example: ಆ ಕಚೇರಿಯ ಅನೌಪಚಾರಿಕತೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ನೌಕರರಿಗೂ ಇಷ್ಟವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: All the employees liked the informality of that office.

definition: any one of a series of moments at which the same or nearly the same thing recurs.
example: ಪ್ರತಿ ಒರ್ವಾರ ಅವನು ಅದೇ ತಪ್ಪನ್ನು ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He repeats the same mistake at every recurring instance.

definition: a hunter who hunts animals, going on foot.
example_en: That foot-hunter chased a deer in the forest.

definition: a shackle or chain for the feet.
example_en: They had put a shackle on the prisoner's leg.

definition: the records required for day-to-day transactions.
example_en: The records of day-to-day transactions are maintained daily in the office.

definition: any of numerous birds of prey of the family Accipitridae, having a short, hooked beak, broad wings, and curved talons, often seen circling or swooping at low altitude; a hawk.
example_en: The hawk swooped low over the hill.

definition: the plant Fumaria indica ( = F. parviflora) of Fumariaceae family, with watery juice and spurred flowers, formerly used in medicine; fumitory.
example_en: The physician used the fumitory plant as a medicine.

definition: a good, healthful food.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ರೋಗಿಗೆ ಒಳ್ಳುಣಿಸು ತಿನ್ನಲು ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor advised the patient to eat healthful food.

definition: a man belonging to a caste the main profession of the members of which is trading and business.
example_en: That kōvaṭi man does cloth trade.

definition: the quality or condition of being dirty; dirtiness.
example_en: The dirtiness of that drain annoyed everyone.

definition: any piece of certain kinds of material, as iron, that has the property of attracting like material; a magnet.
example_en: One can find direction with the help of a magnet.

definition: pretentious valour.
example_en: His pretentious valour deceived the people.

definition: a complicated condition solving of which is difficult.
example_en: The children brought a ball to play with.

definition: a path; a way; a road.
example_en: This path leads to the village.

definition: that branch of a legislature, which has representatives from different walks of life, nominated or indirectly elected based on the merits, that acts as an advisory board to the main representative body of legislature.
example: ರಾಜ್ಯದ ವಿಧಾನಮಂಡಲ ಹೊಸ ನೀತಿಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಲಹೆ ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The state's legislative council gave advice on new policies.

definition: to become dry completely.
example_en: The clothes dried in the sun became completely dry.

definition: shut; closed.
example_en: The windows were shut and the room was dark.

definition: nine times hundred; nine hundred.
example_en: There are nine hundred houses in that village.

definition: to pour a liquid from above; to cause (a liquid) to flow in a stream.
example_en: She poured water from the well with a bucket.

definition: a small piece of a stone.
example_en: Small pieces of stone lay scattered along the path.

definition: a temple (in gen.).
example_en: The devotees went to the temple early in the morning.

definition: Arundo donax of Poaceae family; a tall, stiff water-grass used for mats, roofs etc.; giant reed.
example: ಹಣಜೆಯಿಂದ ಹೆಣೆದ ಚಾಪೆಯನ್ನು ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಾಸಿದರು.
example_en: They spread a mat woven from giant reed on the floor.

definition: to hit or strike repeatedly; to pound; to beat.
example_en: He was repeatedly pounding the iron with a hammer.

definition: a tool having a broad iron blade fixed to a handle used for for digging, pulling the earth, etc.
example_en: The farmer dug the field's soil with the spade.

definition: either of the two feathered forelimbs of a bird, either or not fully developed for flying, for flight, balance in running, for swimming, etc.; a wing.
example_en: The peacock spread its wings and danced.

definition: a small box for holding matches; a match box.
example_en: We have kept a matchbox in the kitchen.

definition: the chief performer.
example_en: He himself was the chief performer in the drama.

definition: a small, water carrier of metal or plastic.
example_en: She filled water in the small water carrier.

definition: a woman who fulfills the desires.
example_en: Everyone worshipped her as the one who fulfills desires.

definition: drinkable water; potable water.
example: ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನನಗೆ ಒಂದು ಲೋಟ ಕುನ್ನೀರು ಕೊಡಿ.
example_en: Please give me a glass of drinkable water.

definition: to cause to contract; to make (something) contracted.
example_en: The heat caused the metal to contract.

definition: a man in the service of another; a servant.
example_en: He worked as a servant in the rich man's house.

definition: the path, way, that is or can be seen.
example_en: The visible path on the hill could be seen from far away.

definition: a room in a building having facilities for taking bath; a bath-room.
example_en: The bathroom of that house was small.

definition: a mattress used to sleep on, consisting of a quilted or similarly fastened case, usu. of heavy cloth; a bed.
example_en: He lay down on a soft mattress.

definition: foolish talk.
example_en: Everyone laughed hearing his foolish talk.

definition: the quality of being heavily salty (as a food item, water, etc.).
example_en: The sea water was heavily salty.

definition: the fact of (a person or thing) belonging to another place, country.
example_en: She experienced a feeling of foreignness abroad.

definition: an indefinite time or period of time; sometime in future.
example_en: This problem may be resolved sometime in the future.

definition: to treat abdominal hernia.
example_en: The doctor treated his abdominal hernia.

definition: heaviness as a quality of things; weight.
example_en: The sack's weight was heavy and hurt his back.

definition: to bring down; to cause to come down.
example_en: The farmers brought down the sacks of grain from the cart.

definition: either of the two fleshy protuberances in humans forming the lower and back part of the trunk; buttock.
example: ಬಿದ್ದ ಮಗು ಪಚ್ಚಳದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದು ಅತ್ತಿತು.
example_en: The child who fell landed on its buttock and cried.

definition: kidnapped; abducted; hijacked.
example_en: The police safely rescued the kidnapped child.

definition: the act of intervweaving or braiding.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಹೂವಿನ ಹೆಣೆತವನ್ನು ಬಹಳ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother did the braiding of the flowers very slowly.
